title: PinLockScreen overlaps its keypad with the hostel name/title on a very short screen
description:
Found incidentally while verifying LODGY-97's PinSetupScreen fix on-device: resized the emulator to 720x1000 (short screen) to check PinSetupScreen's new scroll behavior, and observed PinLockScreen (the unlock screen shown to a returning warden, not the first-time setup screen fixed under LODGY-97) rendering with the numeric keypad overlapping the hostel name and 'Enter your PIN' text - digits and title text drawn on top of each other, both partially readable.

The state that produced this was contrived (files/datastore/auth_prefs.preferences_pb deleted while Room already had a hostel - not reachable through any normal user flow, since PIN setup always precedes hostel setup) - it is NOT confirmed to reproduce on a normal PIN unlock in normal use, only that PinLockScreen's layout doesn't scroll/reflow either. Needs a clean repro (short screen + normal unlock flow, no manual state tampering) before treating this as confirmed - filed so it isn't lost, not confirmed as user-reachable yet.
acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce (or rule out) the overlap on a normal PIN unlock flow at a small/short screen size, without deleting or corrupting any app state manually
If reproducible: PinLockScreen's content no longer overlaps on short screens - apply the same scroll/layout treatment used for PinSetupScreen under LODGY-97 if it applies
If not reproducible under any normal flow: close as not-a-bug with the finding documented, since the only way to trigger it required an impossible combination of stored state

history.note: Surfaced during LODGY-97's on-device verification, not from user report. Deliberately low priority pending a clean repro - the observed state required manually deleting auth_prefs while a hostel already existed in Room, which normal onboarding order (PIN before hostel) cannot produce.
